# HUD grid

A holographic heads-up overlay in the accent color: a fine grid with brighter major lines, corner brackets around the frame, and a slow scan sweep.

<EffectDemo effect="hud-grid" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { hudGrid } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/hud-grid';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(hudGrid({ preset: 'targeting' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.gridSize = 32`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                      | Default     | Range      | Description                               |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `gridSize`   | number                                                    | `32`        | 8 – 128 px | Size of a grid cell.                      |
| `color`      | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#5ad8ff'` |            | Color of the overlay.                     |
| `intensity`  | number                                                    | `0.6`       | 0 – 2      | Brightness of the grid and brackets.      |
| `sweep`      | number                                                    | `0.25`      | 0 – 1      | Brightness of the scan sweep.             |
| `sweepSpeed` | number                                                    | `1`         | 0 – 4      | Sweeps every four seconds at 1.           |
| `fade`       | number                                                    | `0.5`       | 0 – 1      | How much the grid fades toward the edges. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `targeting` | `gridSize: 48`, `intensity: 0.9`, `sweep: 0.4`    |
| `subtle`    | `intensity: 0.3`, `sweep: 0.1`                    |
| `dense`     | `gridSize: 16`, `intensity: 0.4`                  |
| `alert`     | `color: '#ff4d5e'`, `sweep: 0.5`, `sweepSpeed: 2` |

Apply one with `hudGrid({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`sweep: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Cost:** 1.1 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/hud-grid`, including the shared effect runtime.
